title: Evidence
description: Immutable evidence record supporting a finding. Mirrors the Evidence component in openapi.yaml (GET /v1/validations/{id}/evidence). Records are append-only: a correction is issued as a new record referencing 'supersedes', never an edit in place, per the Foundation Validation Spec Evidence Model (Section 5.2).

content_ref.description: URI or content-addressable reference to the evidence payload. Raw content is never inlined in the record.

integrity_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the evidence content, used to detect tampering after capture.

producer.description: Validator or tool that generated this evidence.

supersedes.description: Evidence ID this record replaces, if any.

EvidenceType.description: Category of evidence attached to a finding.
